submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.834% at the allocated rate of 8 kHz. This represents approximately 20 percentage points improvement over Algorithm-L1 (72.553%) and 8.7 percentage points improvement over Algorithm-L3 (84.169%). Simulations across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV) confirm that 30 GeV is optimal for Algorithm-L2, providing slightly better efficiency than neighboring thresholds. All three algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget, but Algorithm-L2's superior performance makes it the clear choice for maximizing signal efficiency.
